trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the reward for unlocking every other trophy on the list, so treat it as the last item on your checklist rather than something you can chase directly. Work through the story, then the collectibles and activities, and it will pop the moment the 54th trophy registers. Nothing here is missable in itself, but any trophy you leave behind delays it.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission that gets the story moving. It is a required early mission, so it cannot be missed on a normal playthrough; the unlock arrives once the mission ends. Even if you skip the cutscenes, the completion still counts.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Follow the objectives to Gone Fishing's end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by finishing every mission it contains. Chapters unlock in order and stay available to replay afterwards, so there is no hidden condition to satisfy. Just keep following the mission markers until the chapter ends.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Replay the chapter later if needed

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in the same way: work through its missions until the final one ends. The trophy is tied to story progress, not to a score or a particular choice. Replaying the chapter also satisfies the requirement if you want a second pass.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Confirm the trophy in the list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. See the chapter through to its final mission and the trophy is awarded with the regular story unlock. There is no side objective attached, so a straightforward playthrough is enough.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Play the chapter's missions to the end and the trophy follows the story progression automatically. Because chapters can be revisited, nothing here can be permanently lost.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This unlocks when you complete the final mission of the main story. It is the natural end of the campaign and cannot be missed if you finish the story. Make a separate save beforehand if you want to revisit the ending afterwards.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, one of the early story missions. Follow the mission markers to the end and the trophy follows automatically. It is not tied to a moral choice or a performance grade.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. This is a scripted story heist, so play it through to the end and watch the result. There is no separate rating to chase, and the unlock is guaranteed by finishing the mission.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Follow the heist plan to the end

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. It is a fixed story mission, so finishing it is enough and there is no alternate route that skips the reward. Keep the mission marker on screen and work through its objectives.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. See the mission through to its ending and the trophy is awarded on completion. How well you perform does not change the unlock, so there is no need to replay for a better result.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Play the mission to its ending

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission as directed and the trophy will register. The airport setting is also worth remembering for the separate unscheduled-departure trophy covered elsewhere in this guide.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Note the airport for later cleanup

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Play the mission to its conclusion and the trophy is granted with the story unlock. Treat it like the other chapter missions: no special condition, just completion.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. This is the overall completion trophy, so it arrives last after story, collectibles, challenges, stranger strands and property purchases are ticked off. Use the game's completion menu to see which categories still need work and chip away at them.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 Stunts. Stunts are counted in free roam, so build a habit of jumping ramps, landing big air and driving on two wheels whenever you travel. The counter carries across sessions, so there is no window in which it must be done.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample every activity category shown on the map rather than mastering any one of them; a single attempt at each is enough. Nothing expires, so this can be left until the activity cleanup phase.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Try one of each activity type

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range and work through every challenge until each one shows a gold result. Replaying challenges is allowed, so you can return with better aim rather than losing the opportunity.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Replay any challenge that falls short

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone-race marker across Leonida and take first place in one race at each site. The locations remain available after the story, making this a tidy map sweep.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Win one race at every site

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter the race markers around the state and win twenty distinct events; repeating the same event does not increase the number of different races. Check the race list after each win and move to a new one.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Win a race you have not won before

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at his fishing spot and accept the challenge, then land a better result than he does. Bring the right rod and bait so the attempt is not wasted.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade and play one of the cabinet games through to its end screen. Any cabinet counts, so this is one of the quickest filler trophies to pick up between other tasks.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Play through to the end screen

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's stranger strand has several steps, so keep returning to his marker until the last mission ends. Because it is a sequence, starting it early makes it easier to track alongside the story.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's side strand through its last mission. The trophy is tied to finishing the chain rather than to a particular score or rating.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's last mission to close out his strand. Keep an eye on the mission marker so the chain does not stall between steps.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Eight different strangers need their full chains finished, not just a first contact. Track each strand in the pause menu and finish the remaining ones during cleanup; none of them require story-specific timing.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Complete each chain to its last mission

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. See Randy's strand to its last mission. The unlock comes from completing the chain, so keep returning to his marker until it is done.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's last mission to close out his strand. There is no scoring requirement, only completion of the chain.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Each meditation spot is a fixed map marker, so travel to each one and finish the meditation animation. The spots stay on the map, which makes this a collectible-style sweep you can do in passes.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's request is a single specific hunt, so use a suitable weapon and approach the animal carefully enough to make a clean kill. The trophy is for that one unique target, not for general hunting, so do it while his request is active.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Make the clean kill before moving on
trophies.missableReason: Bret's hunt is a single unique request, so ignoring his marker while it is active means losing the specific target.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards come in sets that can be collected or traded, so focus on finishing three whole sets instead of hoarding random singles. Check the collectible menu to see which sets are closest to completion.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK prompts are tied to specific spots and objects found while exploring, so sweep the map and trigger each one. The tally accumulates across the whole save and never rolls back.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the timed and skill-based tasks scattered around Leonida, separate from the dedicated Shooting Range set. Pick the easy ones first and work toward fifty; there is no deadline attached.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need a moment where your partner is beside you, then provoke a four-star response and stay together while breaking line of sight. The shared-partner condition makes this worth attempting during the story rather than assuming free roam will always count.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Find a story moment with your partner
Escape together and lose the cops
trophies.missableReason: It needs a story moment with your partner plus a four-star chase; random free-roam play rarely satisfies both at once.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Keep your partner close, hit three shops in quick succession and avoid shaking the police between them. Because it asks for a partner and a continuous wanted level, try it inside a suitable two-character sequence.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Rob three shops without a break
Keep the wanted level active throughout
trophies.missableReason: The partner requirement and the uninterrupted wanted level only line up inside certain two-character sequences.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every vehicle you see or enter for the first time is added to your discovery list, so keep switching rides as you travel. This is a passive count that never resets and needs no special conditions.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Enter Combat Focus in a busy firefight and make each shot count on five different opponents. If you run out of targets, reload the encounter or try a busier location and go again.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The wording points to leaving the airport in an unusual way during the VCIA sequence, so experiment with the route available in that scene instead of using the normal exit. It is tied to that specific location window, so handle it while the airport mission is active.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
trophies.missableReason: The unscheduled departure exists only during the VCIA sequence, so leaving normally closes the chance.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points toward the armoured Rhino vehicles, so take one on directly when a mission or encounter puts you nearby. If the scene allows a replay, use it to try again; do not assume the chance will appear in every free-roam session.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Engage them in the scripted scene
Replay the encounter if it fails
trophies.missableReason: The Rhino encounter is scene-specific and may not appear again if the chapter is left behind.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, plan a quiet entry and leave without triggering an alarm or a witness report. Store robberies can be retried, so a failed stealth attempt does not close the door on the trophy.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Escape with a clean stealth run

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are repeatable robberies; hit five different vaults and successfully get away from each one. Use a reliable getaway plan so a failed escape does not waste the attempt.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Wait for an armored truck on the map, stop it, take the cash and get clear of the police. The attempt can be repeated, so treat this as a straightforward free-roam robbery rather than a one-shot event.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Stop it and take the cash

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map opens up as the story progresses, so keep uncovering it and visiting every region. It is the exploration counterpart to the other map sweeps and cannot be lost once an area is discovered.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang controls an operation you can hit; clear at least one for every gang on the list. Track which gangs are left and finish the remainder in free roam.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: List the gangs and their operations

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a small story-linked moment rather than an ordinary bar purchase, so pay attention when the game places you on Ocean Beach with a drink in hand. It belongs to a specific early scene and is easy to overlook if you rush past the dialogue.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Reach the Ocean Beach story scene
Take part in the cocktail moment
Replay the chapter if you skipped it
trophies.missableReason: The cocktail moment belongs to one early Ocean Beach scene and is easy to skip in dialogue.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description hints at a particular escape from a showroom during a story sequence, not general vehicle damage. Follow the scene's scripted opportunity to drive out through the glass instead of leaving normally.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Smash out in the requested style
trophies.missableReason: The showroom smash-out is a scripted escape, not something you can trigger at any showroom later.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. This is a precise action tied to the bowling alley visit in a story scene, so complete the bowling motion rather than skipping it. If the moment passes, a chapter replay is the safest way to try again.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Visit Kolt & Associates in the story
trophies.missableReason: A precise follow-through is needed during the bowling-alley scene; skipping the animation loses it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The cryptic wording hides a specific partnership moment in the story, so pay attention to scenes built around the two leads working together. Because it is tied to one scene, treat it as a story-time trophy and keep your eyes open.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
steps: Take part in the featured moment
Use chapter select if you miss it
trophies.missableReason: The partnership moment is embedded in one story scene and is not a repeatable free-roam activity.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This hidden trophy tracks decisions you make during the campaign, so let the story play out and keep making choices rather than avoiding them. The count accumulates across the story, which makes it hard to finish the game without earning it.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A failed first attempt followed by a successful retry is the pattern here, so do not be discouraged by an initial failure in a mission or challenge. Watch for a scenario that explicitly invites a second go and take it.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
trophies.missableReason: It relies on a specific fail-then-retry situation rather than on a counter you can grind later.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is one of the game's strange, out-of-the-ordinary encounters; the reward arrives when you witness one. Keep exploring and taking side routes rather than only following the main path, because a scripted oddity is easy to walk past.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
trophies.missableReason: The strange encounter is a scripted oddity on an optional route, so simply following the main path misses it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The wording points to knocking someone down from a vehicle during the bowling-alley sequence. Set up the drive-by melee during that scene instead of trying it later in an unrelated area of the map.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
trophies.missableReason: The drive-by melee belongs to the bowling-alley sequence and cannot be recreated elsewhere.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills through the laundering contacts available to you and keep going until the profit reaches the quarter-million target. The counter persists, so you can build it up over several sessions.
trophies.source: Sources: TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy list (https://www.truetrophies.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buying clothes, vehicles, weapons or upgrades all count as shop spending, so invest in things you actually want. The total accumulates, so there is no need to splurge in a single trip.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Work through the property list and buy every garage once you can afford it. Ownership is permanent, so this is a straightforward money sink to finish during the endgame cleanup.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register vehicles you have acquired until ten are logged. Keep track of what you have already registered so you do not waste time on duplicates.
trophies.source: Sources: PlayStationTrophies GTA VI guide (https://www.playstationtrophies.org) and the official PSN trophy descriptions in this entry.
